archetypes.name: dyn-fence-parser
archetypes.rationale: Fence parsing and adjacency semantics are the core regression risk.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review python/lint_consecutive_bash.py for Markdown fence parsing fidelity. Focus on line-number preservation, opener and closer matching, CRLF/BOM handling, and whether the breadcrumb gap rules match the planned static source-adjacent model. Check that suppressions require reasons and do not accidentally hide unrelated single-line fences. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-skill-boundaries
archetypes.rationale: The change edits runtime skill prompts to satisfy a new lint.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the SKILL.md and references suppressions added for first-run cleanup. Verify each pragma preserves the original orchestration behavior and uses the correct placement form, especially the single-line skills/implement/SKILL.md launcher fence covered by test-implement-fence-shape.sh. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-lint-wiring
archetypes.rationale: New lint wiring spans CLI dispatch, Makefile shards, pre-commit, and docs.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the CLI, Makefile, pre-commit, and docs wiring for the new lint. Confirm the hook file filter matches the same scoped surfaces as the linter, the Makefile target is included in make lint and one harness shard, and the documented invocation names match the implemented cli.py dispatch. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
